notes.title: 【Update0119】New difficulty added in DLC2, new skins!
notes.content:
Hello dear players! Today marks the two-year anniversary of the launch of Warm Snow! Thank you very much for your company over the past two years! ːsteamthumbsupː
After the release of DLC2, we collected feedback from everyone and made some new content! Let's take a look together~

[b]New content:[/b]
1. New difficulty level - Chaotic Breakpoint
DLC2 will add a new challenge difficulty level - Chaotic Breakpoint, which can be switched to through the Benevolent Mother after passing the Wood Pig Line.
In this level, monsters will have a stronger desire to attack, and some of the boss's skills will have partial changes, so be careful to deal with them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996546/23aed2afac34f68256304455f1b75a2e1f8f0b61.gif[/img]
2. A new set of skins for Bi'an, which can be unlocked after passing the Wood Pig Line, and changed in the lower left corner of the Buddha statue。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996546/740f39a25aad58c4e2662780e69a59573479288b.jpg[/img]
3. Lady Blood will sell 7 new DLC2 Red Soul Trials

4. Add an endless mode that can only be entered through DLC2, in which only the Heart of All Things talent can be used to challenge endless DLC2 levels and bosses!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996546/92d5045c481011ee77f06983d413931d3cf766e2.gif[/img]
5. When the player's Heart of All Things point count reaches its upper limit (43 points), the Infinite Heart of All Things mode can be activated: You will be given 86 points, but this mode will not record the clearance time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996546/8c33bf59f693b7b491669ed8665033face292203.gif[/img]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
1. Fixed the bug that the Lunar Frost Blade of the <Wheels of Solar and Lunar> has a chance of not coming out.
2. Fixed the bug that the Tiger Boss in the main game was triggered prematurely, causing the Tiger Boss to stand still.
3. Fixed the bug that the Dragon Emperor Boss in the main game was triggered prematurely, causing it to be unable to enter the combat area.

————

notes.title: 【1207】长按抽残响、故事碎片爆率提高，常见问题修复
notes.content:

[b]Experience Optimization:[/b]
1. Added the feature to continuously draw Tailsman by long-pressing.
2. The room for drawing Talismans can now yield Boss Talismans.
3. Significantly increased the number of rooms where the "Old Genealogy" story fragment appears.

5. Added a level cap hint to the "Heart of All Things" talent page.
6. Reduced the number of hits required to break the "Sphere of Awareness."

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
1. Fixed an issue in DLC2 where the Infinite Gourd would prevent healing in the base game and DLC1.
2. In DLC2, talents that grant base Soul Vessels will no longer receive bonuses from talents and difficulty levels.
3. Fixed a bug where there was a chance that the character's animation direction would remain fixed after being knocked down.
4. Fixed an issue where the "Sleeping Arhat" could continue to appear even after getting up.

6. Fixed an issue where consecutive playthroughs would cause the final boss not to drop the "Memory of Fengyue·Three."
7. Fixed an issue where the "Seal of the Great Mother" and "Not Your Time" skills would cause self-death when Sheathing.
8. Fixed an issue where using a controller to rapidly press the interaction key would cause the ending selection interface to open too quickly, preventing the selection of other endings.
9. Fixed an issue where the "Carousing Acala's" Sheathing effect would not extend its duration when released in rapid succession with a short cooldown.
10. Fixed an issue in DLC2 where learning the "Imbibe" talent would prevent healing in the base game.

notes.title: [1206]Optimization of Early Game Experience and Difficulty, bug fixes
notes.content:
Version：3.0.0.2

[b]Experience Optimization:[/b]
1. The initial talent points have been increased from 10 to 20, with the default cap raised to 41.
2. The reward for clearing the true ending, "Heroic Hymn," has been adjusted from adding 1 talent point to adding 2.
3. Talent Plate adjustments: Players will now start with 4 gourds and basic refinement abilities, along with instant health regeneration.
- Original gourd talent effects modified to +1/+2.
- Refinement talent effects modified to refinement effect +0.5%/1%.
- Mask Medicine modified to "One More Gourd," granting a 25% chance not to consume a "Gourd" when used.
4. Optimized the overall difficulty curve for Wood Rat Line and reduced the AI difficulty for the minor boss "QingYi" in the "Chapter Of Pig ."
5. Adjusted the drop rate of Orange Soul for both minor and major bosses.
6. Strengthened the guidance for the Talisman system for newcomers.
7. Reduced the chance of Blue Soul Rooms appearing and increased the chance of Reward Rooms appearing.
8. Increased the appearance rate of Ultimate Echoes(talisman).
9. Modified the skills or effects of "Thundering Palm" , "Empyreal Ice", "True Fire of Samadhi" , "Unyielding Swords" , "Rekindled Spirit", "Double Fall", "Reversal" , "Righteous Wind" , and "Final Stand" for improved versatility.
10. Further weakened the Green Self-Destructing enemies, removed their poison upon death, reduced their explosion radius, and made them no longer explode upon death.
11. Adjusted the Shield Mage's shield duration to 5 seconds and removed the re-shielding effect after killing a mage.
12. Added an attack range indicator for the Purple Blade skill of the Divine Empress.
13. Auto-lock for red Talisman. 
14. Modified the numbers of Orange Soul for upgrades.
15. The first stage of the (Wolf Chapter) will no longer feature the "Giant Flower Ghost".

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
1. Fixed a bug where the player's animation direction would become stuck.
2. Fixed a bug where tthe Minor bosses will now properly drop Orange Soul.
3. Corrected an issue with "Feng Yin" and "Slave General" where the next stage wouldn't provide rewards.
4. Optimized the quick Talisman dissolution text and added Orange Soul gain prompts.
5. Soul jars in Soul Rooms now correctly receive increased Blue Soul gain bonuses.

————

notes.title: Future plans for Warm Snow!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40996546/65a74c46287cd7c2d8cc3aa837eaea729e162995.png[/img]
Hi players,

Thank you so much to everyone who bought ‘Warm Snow’, it's your support that makes us have the power and confidence to continue to move forward.

Since launching, we've received a lot of feedback, suggestions, and requests for improvements from our players, and lots of you are eager to hear about our future plans, so today we're going to show you them.

First, ‘Warm Snow’ are going to be updated for a long time to come. But because of our limited team size, our current plan in terms is to keep launch new contents monthly. Monthly update will include new roles, relics, excalibur, NPCS, and performance optimization. 
At the same time, our DLC plan has been formally finalized and will start work soon. The target of release is in this summer! The DLC will include new storylines and game modes, so we won't reveal too much right now (keep it a mystery and a surprise)!

Second, we plan to release the first content update for the game before Chinese New Year. It will include:

[b]*New NPCS - Soul Blacksmith:[/b]

Function 1: Strengthen the excalibur, you can consume the soul to strengthen the excalibur quality (has a chance to fail).
Function 2: changing effects, you can consume the soul to refresh random excalibur effect.
Function 3: Give you encouragement when your reinforcement fails.

[b]* 5 new relics[/b]
[b]
* 6 new excalibur[/b]

In the early updates, our main goal was to enhance the roles that are currently less powerful on high difficulty and to enrich the gameplay of other roles by adding equipment and skills. In the future, we will continue to improve the game as we develop new modes and live up to everyone's expectations and love.

Finally, feel free to give us valuable comments! Maybe the inspiration of future creation comes from your idea!

-- BadMudstudio
